msg: I focussed on the shape of the hats, dividing the gnomes into two sets based on colour. This seemed to work reasonably well. So for example in one colour set there seemed to be a trend of pointed hats resulting in multiple mushrooms for a while. It does also seem to change throughout the game, so you need to respond to that change. I thought about whether there was anything more sophisticated (streaks, or which side the gnomes appeared) but didn't really test this.
